title: RTSP server
description: The programme served over RTSP, for decoders, recorders, NVRs and players that pull a stream from an address.

port.title: Port
port.description: The TCP port players connect to. It opens when this output starts and closes when it stops. 8554 is the usual choice; 554 needs the machine's administrator.

path.title: Path
path.description: What comes after the port in the address: live gives rtsp://<this machine>:8554/live.

bind.title: Listen on
bind.description: The address to accept players on. 0.0.0.0 is every network this machine is on; 127.0.0.1 keeps it to this machine.
